sources: championsbattledata.com species and move reference data (data/champions)
notes: Species: the latest ladder snapshot's top 50 plus every species with at least 5 tournament-team appearances in the M-C window 2026-09-09 to 2026-09-28 (395 teams). A species with no qualifying tournament build (0 of 60 here) uses the ladder snapshot's own top item, ability, nature, and one real spread instead, labelled a "ladder set".

Every tournament build's spread is a real tournament team's exact spread (the band's median-nearest representative), never an average across builds; a ladder-set's spread is the snapshot's own most-reported spread row, also never averaged.

Damage cells for a row with no listed deviation are computed live by the page's formula.mjs, checked against this same engine by engine/test/test-damage-ref.js. A row with a deviation shows the engine's own precomputed grid (this file) with a badge instead.

defender.note: A flat 90/90/90 base HP/Def/SpD, 0 stat points, neutral nature, no type of its own: Ampharos stands in only because calc_damage needs a real Pokémon to run, and its stored stats and type are overridden to this exact preset (its own base Def is 85, not 90) so the engine grid always matches the page's slider default exactly.

attackerPhysical.note: Falinks at 32 Atk points, Adamant nature (Atk 167): base Atk is 100 exactly, forced to a neutral type (its own is Fighting) so the tab measures bulk, not a Fighting-type matchup. Cross Chop is its own 100 BP move (also forced neutral), matching the old page's '100 Atk / 100BP STAB' preset with a real Pokémon and move behind it; STAB still applies (1.5x by default, following the page's own STAB buttons) since the neutral-typed move matches the neutral-typed attacker.

attackerSpecial.note: Milotic at 32 SpA points, Modest nature (SpA 167): base SpA is 100 exactly, forced to a neutral type (its own is Water) so the tab measures bulk, not a Water-type matchup. Hydro Pump (single-target, Special) is its move, forced neutral and to 100 BP so it matches the page's '100BP STAB' preset exactly (no Champions Water special is single-target at 100 BP); STAB still applies (1.5x by default) the same way as the physical benchmark's.
